data.name: Olwen
data.long_meaning: Olwen is a Welsh name derived from the Old Welsh word 'olwen', which means 'white sheen' or 'fawn'. In Welsh mythology, Olwen was the name of a beautiful maiden who was said to be the cause of the magic of the flowers in the Garden of Rhos. She was also the name of a fairy queen who was known for her beauty, grace, and power.
